environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task but deployed via the organization's hardened task definition template. The task definition specifies a custom OCI runtime configuration with a JSON-formatted syscall filter (compatible with containerd's runtime spec) that enumerates an allowlist of 78 syscalls required for JVM operation. The filter's default action is SCMP_ACT_ERRNO with errno 1 (EPERM). Notably, the allowlist was generated from a 72-hour production trace and includes openat, read, write, close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, brk, futex, clone (for JVM threads), but explicitly omits execve, execveat, fexecve, ptrace, and symlinkat. The symlinkat omission means the kernel will reject any attempt to create symbolic links within the container, and the execve omission means ProcessBuilder.start() will fail with IOException (EPERM) even if a file is written. The filter is applied at the container runtime level via linuxSecurityContext in the ECS task definition's containerDefinitions[0].linuxParameters.devices configuration, referencing a Bottlerocket host-level seccomp profile stored at /etc/containerd/seccomp-processor.json.

config.filesystem: EFS mount at /var/spool/processor/output with noexec mount option
config.network: VPC with no outbound internet (egress restricted to AWS service endpoints only)
config.sqs_queue_policy: allows SendMessage from multiple AWS accounts
